purpose: Configuration and separation policy for the MARKET-OPEN graded-DCA stream: a single 9:35 AM ET live Robinhood execution (cron 2ba19526, run_type='market_open_dca_live', trades=true) on account <ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER>. It uses the SAME shared 0x-to-5x ladder and dynamic $1/$2 base, the same active universe (excluding the whole-share tickers BYDDY and RVII), and the same shared $180/$900 Normal-tier ceiling as every other live stream. It is INDEPENDENT of, and never valid evidence for, the morning (42173154), midday (a6239dae), intraday (7be82b97), or afternoon (10ce362c) streams.
added_reason: Until now this slot had no in-repo Python entry point (config/scheduled_tasks.json:2ba19526 no_python_entry_point=true): an external scheduler/agent ran it directly from the task manifest's prose, so NONE of this repo's code enforced its trading-window cutoff, budget ledger, per-order ceiling, or same-day top-up guard. market_open_dca.py closes that gap by reusing the same MorningDCAExecutor pipeline the 10:30 and 12:30 streams already run on.
live_execution_enabled_note: PROMOTED TO ENABLED. Live Robinhood execution is authorized across regular trading hours per operator confirmation on 2026-10-04.
confidence_rule: Trend validation is DISABLED for this slot (see trend_validation_exemption). A candidate whose price/drop passes the ladder is auto-buy eligible without a validated 60-minute intraday downtrend. Every other circuit breaker -- whitelist, budget caps, buying power, spread threshold, data confidence, per-order ceiling, regular-hours-only -- stays fully enforced.

trend_validation_exemption.decision: User-confirmed 2026-07-27 (config/scheduled_tasks.json:2ba19526.trend_validation_exemption); mirrored here because market_open_dca.py now enforces it in code rather than leaving it to an external agent.
trend_validation_exemption.reason: At 9:35 AM ET only five minutes of regular-session data exist, but the shared strategy contract's trend validation requires a completed 60-minute intraday downtrend. Requiring it here made every market-open buy impossible to validate, zeroing the slot. Exempted for this task only.

live_task.name: Weekday 9:35 AM market-open DCA live Robinhood execution
live_task.note: Live Robinhood execution using account <ROBINHOOD_ACCOUNT_NUMBER> (Alpaca/Finance/Yahoo stay read-only for validation/context). As the day's first buy it normally has no prior same-day allocation and places the full desired amount; its fills become prior-allocation context for every later same-day slot.
live_task.preflight_independence: This slot fires at 9:35, ten minutes BEFORE the 9:45 pre-flight writer (bb4f6ef1). It must never gate on the pre-flight artifact -- that artifact does not exist yet when this run decides. Only the 10:30 morning stream consumes it.

state_file_guarantee.summary: The 9:35 scheduled run MUST always write run_state.json, run_summary.json, market_open_signals.csv, and a header-only-when-empty submitted_orders.csv under the market-open root, plus latest_market_open_run.json, even when no orders are placed or execution is blocked.
state_file_guarantee.evidence_meaning: A blocked/no-order artifact is valid proof that the 9:35 scheduled task FIRED, but it is NOT order or fill evidence.
state_file_guarantee.no_silent_escalation: Do NOT escalate without writing this state file unless the workspace itself is unavailable.

sizing_ladder.name: market_open_0x_to_5x
sizing_ladder.tier_boundary_rule: min inclusive, max exclusive; the largest tier threshold <= actual drop wins; drop < 0.1% = 0x (no buy).
sizing_ladder.separation_note: This is the SAME shared 0x-to-5x live ladder every live stream uses (config/sizing_ladder.json). Max per order is 5x * $2 = $10.

budget_ledger.shared_pool_note: The shared Normal-tier ceiling every stream draws from (near_close_dca.BUDGET_TIERS[0], mirrored in config/budgets.json). cap_seed_roots below spans every sibling stream so this ledger sees the whole day's/week's cross-stream spend rather than only its own. Like morning and midday, this slot does not independently escalate to Elevated/High-volatility/Stress -- only the 3:30 final run does, from its fuller same-day view -- so it is only ever more conservative than the true escalated-day ceiling, never less.
budget_ledger.supersedes_manifest_note: This replaces the external-agent-enforced ledger described in config/scheduled_tasks.json:2ba19526.budget_ledger, whose cap_pooling_update_2026_08_02 note explains that market-open could not read pooled state back because it had no in-repo Python. It can now.

top_up_rule.description: As the day's first slot this run normally finds no prior same-day allocation and places the full desired amount. The guard still runs so that a hand-placed manual recovery fill earlier the same day is honoured: the run then buys only max(0, desired - prior_same_day_amount), and only when its decision price is strictly below the prior same-day reference price.
top_up_rule.reference_price_preference: The prior same-day reference price is resolved in this order: the run's logged target_price, then decision_price, then the confirmed average_fill_price (from orders.csv or a manual override's filled_orders.csv). A missing reference price means no automatic top-up: the candidate is flagged top_up_manual_review (manual_review_candidate) at $0.
top_up_rule.prior_allocation_sources: Only hand-placed manual recovery artifacts can precede 9:35, so prior_allocation_roots below is deliberately limited to the roots that can hold them. Every scheduled sibling stream fires later in the day and contributes nothing to this slot.

artifact_paths.prior_allocation_roots_note: Deliberately narrower than the sibling streams' lists. Nothing scheduled runs before 9:35, so the only same-day prior allocation possible is a hand-placed manual fill. market_open_dca (this stream's own root) is included because MarketOpenDCAExecutor.run(..., manual=True) writes a successful manual recovery fill under its own market_open_dca/manual_runs tree -- omitting it left a recovery order placed shortly before 9:35 invisible to the scheduled invocation's own top-up guard, which saw no prior allocation and fell into the broad duplicate skip instead of submitting the intended incremental top-up (Codex review: 'Include market-open manual runs in the loaded roots'; matches default_market_open_prior_allocation_roots() in market_open_dca.py, which this checked-in list otherwise overrides). morning_dca is included because load_prior_same_day_allocations recurses, so it catches morning_dca/manual_recovery/YYYYMMDD_* (the documented missed-morning recovery root); final_manual_review catches the out-of-tree manual final-buy override root. All three contribute nothing on a normal day.
artifact_paths.cap_seed_roots_note: Every sibling stream, including this stream's own root so a restart/retry re-seeds from its own prior fills. Unlike prior_allocation_roots (which feeds only the PER-TICKER top-up guard's reference price), this feeds the shared daily/weekly cap. The later-firing siblings contribute nothing at 9:35 on a normal day, but listing them keeps a same-day retry or out-of-order recovery correctly pooled.
artifact_paths.separation_note: The market-open stream writes ONLY under its own root. It never writes into the morning, midday, intraday, or afternoon roots, never updates latest_scheduled_run.json, and never touches afternoon scheduled_runs/ folders.

downstream_separation_rules: A market-open run_state has stream='market_open', valid_morning_evidence=false, and valid_afternoon_evidence=false; consumers must exclude it from every other stream's scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics.
The market-open stream does not update latest_scheduled_run.json or write into any other stream's folders.

Market-open fills count as PRIOR-ALLOCATION CONTEXT for the same-day top-up guard of every later slot (10:30, 11:30, 12:30, 1:30, 2:30, 3:30); they are never those streams' scheduled evidence, slippage, watchdog confirmation, scheduled cost basis, or scheduled fill counts.
This slot must never gate on the 9:45 pre-flight artifact -- it fires ten minutes earlier.
